name: ask
description: Put one question to several models at once — the host model, OpenAI Codex, and a cheap third via OpenCode — and show all the answers side by side. No judging, no consensus: three opinions, the user picks. Use for "ask everyone", "what do the other models think", "second opinion", "multi ask", or any open question where one model's answer is not enough.
